description: Move a booked visit, change who is dispatched to it, or both. The job's own schedule follows the visit, so moving the appointment moves the job. Requires a full-access Housecall Pro API key. This does not itself email or text the customer. Housecall Pro still sends its own reminders as the date approaches, and that depends on your account's settings. Housecall Pro requires the visit's start and end on every update to this route, even when only the technicians are changing, so they are read back from the appointment for you when you do not name them. Every appointment needs at least one technician - an update that assigns nobody is refused here rather than sent. Housecall Pro checks the technicians before it looks the appointment up, so a complaint about them tells you nothing about whether the appointment id is real.

arrival_window_minutes.description: How wide an arrival window to give the customer, in minutes. Housecall Pro accepts 0, 15, 20, 60, 120, 180 or 240 and rejects anything else. Omit to keep the current window.

employee_ids.description: Technicians to dispatch (pro_... ids from hcp_list_employees), replacing whoever is on the visit now. Omit to keep the current crew. At least one technician must end up assigned.

end_time.description: New ISO 8601 end. Omit to keep the visit where it is.

start_time.description: New ISO 8601 start. Omit to keep the visit where it is.

name: hcp_update_job_appointment
